summary: Backend-only testing for Hipotecas San Sebastián API. Ran 14 pytest cases covering /api/health, /api/simulate (francés + americano, LTV validation, zero-rate edges, term/loan validators) and /api/contact (full + minimum payload, invalid email 422, GET listing persistence and _id exclusion). All 14 tests PASSED against the public preview URL.

minor.issue: logger is defined at module bottom (line ~311) but is referenced inside _send_resend and submit_contact (lines 211, 221, 224, 276). Works at request time because module finishes importing before any request, but it's fragile — recommend moving logging.basicConfig and logger=getLogger above the route/helpers.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and `logging.basicConfig(...)` above the helper functions and routes in server.py to avoid relying on module-load ordering.
critical_code_review_comments: Logger ordering issue (see minor backend issue) — defensive cleanup only, no runtime bug observed.
GET /api/contact correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection ({_id:0}) and the Pydantic ContactRequest serializer — verified by test.
/api/simulate gracefully handles annual_rate=0 for both systems and enforces term_months<=60 and loan_amount>0 via Pydantic Field constraints — verified.
RESEND_API_KEY blank => _send_resend returns False without raising; /api/contact still returns received=true. Correct fallback behavior.
seed_data_creation: Test contacts inserted into MongoDB contact_requests collection with TEST_ prefix (4 documents). No cleanup performed — main agent may purge TEST_* docs if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reuse it for regression. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally empty so email_sent=false and email_configured=false are EXPECTED, not bugs.
